items.def_en: A sudden, abnormal drop in yield beyond the expected baseline.
items.example: We detected a yield excursion on lot A123 during wafer sort in WW32.
items.example_zh: 我們在 WW32 的 wafer sort 發現批號 A123 出現良率異常。

items.def_en: The electrical test performed on each die while it is still on the wafer.
items.example: All affected lots were re-tested at wafer sort before we released them.
items.example_zh: 所有受影響的批次在放行前都重新做了一次 wafer sort。

items.def_en: The characteristic pattern of a failure that points to its likely cause.
items.example: The failure signature is a ring pattern at the wafer edge, not random defects.
items.example_zh: 失效特徵是晶圓邊緣的環狀分佈，不是隨機缺陷。

items.def_en: The underlying reason a problem occurred, not just the visible symptom.
items.example: The root cause was a drifting chamber pressure on furnace tool F02.
items.example_zh: 根本原因是 F02 爐管的腔體壓力漂移。

items.def_en: Immediate action taken to stop bad material from reaching the customer.
items.example: As containment, we put all sister lots on hold and added a screening test.
items.example_zh: 作為圍堵措施，我們扣住所有同期批並加了一道篩選測試。

items.def_en: A permanent fix that removes the root cause so the issue will not recur.
items.example: The corrective action is a tighter pressure spec with automatic tool shutdown.
items.example_zh: 矯正措施是收緊壓力規格，並加上機台自動停機。

items.def_en: A status that blocks a lot from moving to the next process step.
items.example: We placed a lot hold on twelve wafers pending the FA result.
items.example_zh: 我們對十二片晶圓下了批次扣留，等 FA 結果出來再說。

items.def_en: A category that a tested die is sorted into according to its test result.
items.example: The bin 7 failure rate jumped from 0.4% to 3.1% in one week.
items.example_zh: bin 7 的失效率一週內從 0.4% 跳到 3.1%。

items.def_en: The number of defects per unit area on a wafer.
items.example: Defect density at the metal layer doubled after the tool maintenance.
items.example_zh: 機台保養後，金屬層的缺陷密度變成兩倍。

items.def_en: The range of process settings within which the product still meets spec.
items.example: The new recipe gives us a wider process window at the same throughput.
items.example_zh: 新配方在相同產出下給了我們更寬的製程窗口。

items.def_en: The normal, expected performance level used as a reference for comparison.
items.example: Yield returned to baseline two weeks after the corrective action.
items.example_zh: 矯正措施導入兩週後，良率回到基準水準。

items.def_en: The threshold that triggers an alarm and an investigation when crossed.
items.example: Lot A123 crossed the excursion limit, so the system alerted us automatically.
items.example_zh: 批號 A123 超過異常界限，系統自動發出警報。

items.def_en: Cell data corruption caused by repeated reads of neighbouring word lines.
items.example: We reproduced the read disturb failures after one million read cycles.
items.example_zh: 我們在一百萬次讀取後重現了讀取干擾的失效。

items.def_en: Unintended threshold voltage shift in cells next to the one being programmed.
items.example: Program disturb was ruled out because the fail bits sit on unrelated pages.
items.example_zh: 寫入干擾已被排除，因為失效位元落在不相關的 page 上。

items.def_en: How many program and erase cycles a block can take before it fails.
items.example: The device still meets the 3,000-cycle endurance spec after the change.
items.example_zh: 變更後元件仍符合 3,000 次的耐久度規格。

items.def_en: The ability of a cell to keep its data over time without power.
items.example: Retention was verified with a 168-hour bake at 125 degrees Celsius.
items.example_zh: 資料保存力已用 125°C、168 小時的高溫烘烤驗證。

items.def_en: The fraction of bits read incorrectly, usually written as RBER.
items.example: The raw bit error rate stayed below the ECC budget in all corner conditions.
items.example_zh: 在所有極端條件下，原始位元錯誤率都低於 ECC 的容許量。

items.def_en: The formal test program that proves a product or change is ready for production.
items.example: The qualification report will be ready before the customer audit in WW38.
items.example_zh: 認證報告會在 WW38 客戶稽核前完成。

items.def_en: Accelerated testing under harsh conditions to expose long-term weaknesses.
items.example: No new failures appeared after 500 hours of reliability stress.
items.example_zh: 在 500 小時的可靠度應力測試後沒有出現新的失效。

items.def_en: A high-temperature test that screens out parts likely to fail early.
items.example: We added a temporary burn-in step until the root cause is confirmed.
items.example_zh: 在根本原因確認前，我們暫時加了一道高溫老化測試。

items.def_en: One individual chip cut from a wafer.
items.example: Only three die per wafer failed, and all of them sit at the same location.
items.example_zh: 每片晶圓只有三顆晶粒失效，而且位置都相同。

items.def_en: A picture showing where passing and failing die sit on the wafer.
items.example: The wafer map shows a clear edge ring, which points to the anneal step.
items.example_zh: 晶圓分佈圖顯示明顯的邊緣環，指向退火製程。

items.def_en: A sliced view of a device used to inspect its internal structure.
items.example: The cross-section confirmed a void in the tungsten plug.
items.example_zh: 剖面分析確認鎢插塞裡有空洞。

items.def_en: The investigation that identifies how and why a part failed.
items.example: Failure analysis on the two returned units will take about ten working days.
items.example_zh: 兩顆退回品的失效分析大約需要十個工作天。

items.def_en: The ability to track a part back to its lot, tool and process history.
items.example: Traceability data lets us tie every failing unit to the same furnace batch.
items.example_zh: 履歷追溯資料讓我們把每顆失效品連回同一個爐批。

items.def_en: Another lot processed on the same tool at nearly the same time.
items.example: Two sister lots are on hold until the screening result comes back.
items.example_zh: 兩個同期批先扣住，等篩選結果回來再說。

items.def_en: The numbered week of the year, commonly written as WW32 in fab schedules.
items.example: The fix will be in production from work week 35 onward.
items.example_zh: 修正措施會從 WW35 開始導入量產。

items.def_en: A small production run used to evaluate a change before full release.
items.example: The trial run covered three lots and showed no yield impact.
items.example_zh: 試產做了三個批次，沒有看到良率影響。

items.def_en: Analysis that checks whether failing lots share the same equipment.
items.example: Tool commonality analysis pointed to furnace F02 in every failing lot.
items.example_zh: 機台共通性分析指出每個失效批都經過 F02 爐管。

items.def_en: A group of wafers processed with one condition changed on purpose.
items.example: The high-temperature split recovered the yield by 2.8 points.
items.example_zh: 高溫分組把良率拉回了 2.8 個百分點。

items.def_en: An asymmetric shift in a distribution away from its normal centre.
items.example: We saw a skew in the threshold voltage distribution toward the high side.
items.example_zh: 我們看到臨界電壓分佈往高的一側偏斜。

items.def_en: Reprocessing a wafer to correct a step that did not meet spec.
items.example: Six wafers went through rework and passed the follow-up inspection.
items.example_zh: 六片晶圓經過重工，並通過後續檢查。

items.def_en: To discard material that cannot be repaired or shipped.
items.example: We decided to scrap the two worst wafers instead of shipping them.
items.example_zh: 我們決定報廢最差的兩片晶圓，而不是出貨。

items.def_en: The ongoing improvement of yield as defects are found and removed.
items.example: Yield learning on this node is about one point per work week.
items.example_zh: 這個製程節點的良率學習大約是每週一個百分點。

items.def_en: A concrete item you promise to hand over by an agreed date.
items.example: The deliverable for this week is the interim 8D report, not the full analysis.
items.example_zh: 這週的交付項目是 8D 期中報告，不是完整分析。

items.def_en: A checkpoint in a schedule that marks meaningful progress.
items.example: The next milestone is the qualification review in WW38.
items.example_zh: 下一個里程碑是 WW38 的認證審查。

items.def_en: Anyone affected by a decision whose input or approval matters.
items.example: Please confirm with all stakeholders before we freeze the recipe.
items.example_zh: 在凍結配方前請先跟所有利害關係人確認。

items.def_en: To raise an issue to a higher level when it cannot be solved locally.
items.example: If the supplier misses the date again, we will escalate to their management.
items.example_zh: 如果供應商再度延期，我們會上呈到他們的管理層。

items.def_en: To make sure two sides agree on the same plan or understanding.
items.example: Let us align on the containment scope before we reply to the customer.
items.example_zh: 我們先對齊圍堵範圍，再回覆客戶。

items.def_en: A firm promise on scope, quality or date that others will plan around.
items.example: I can give you a commitment on the containment date, but not on the root cause yet.
items.example_zh: 我可以承諾圍堵完成日期，但根本原因還不行。

items.def_en: A limit on time, capacity or resources that shapes what is possible.
items.example: Our main constraint is tester capacity, not engineering effort.
items.example_zh: 我們主要的限制是測試機台產能，不是工程人力。

items.def_en: A backup plan or extra buffer kept in case things go wrong.
items.example: The schedule includes one week of contingency for retest.
items.example_zh: 時程裡留了一週的緩衝給重測。

items.def_en: A difference between two sets of data or statements that should match.
items.example: There is a discrepancy between our sort data and the customer incoming data.
items.example_zh: 我們的針測資料和客戶的來料檢驗資料之間有落差。

items.def_en: Whether a plan can realistically be done with the time and resources available.
items.example: We will check the feasibility of a two-week schedule and reply by Friday.
items.example_zh: 我們會評估兩週時程的可行性，週五前回覆。

items.def_en: A consequence that follows from a fact or decision, often not stated directly.
items.example: The main implication is that shipment will slip by one work week.
items.example_zh: 主要的影響是出貨會延後一個工作週。

items.def_en: To reduce how serious or how likely a risk is.
items.example: To mitigate the risk, we added a 100% screening test at final test.
items.example_zh: 為了降低風險，我們在終測加了 100% 全檢。

items.def_en: To decide which items get attention and resources first.
items.example: We prioritized the customer return over the internal experiment.
items.example_zh: 我們把客訴退回品排在內部實驗前面。

items.def_en: The reasoning behind a decision, explained so others can judge it.
items.example: Slide 4 gives the rationale for keeping the original spec limit.
items.example_zh: 第 4 頁說明維持原規格上限的理由。

items.def_en: To simplify a process so it takes fewer steps or less time.
items.example: We streamlined the review so the 8D can be released in five days.
items.example_zh: 我們簡化了審查流程，讓 8D 五天內就能發出。

items.def_en: A temporary way to keep going while the real fix is being developed.
items.example: The screening test is only a workaround until the new recipe is released.
items.example_zh: 篩選測試只是暫行對策，等新配方發布就會撤掉。

items.def_en: The spare time and attention a person or team has for extra work.
items.example: My team does not have the bandwidth to run both experiments this week.
items.example_zh: 我的團隊這週沒有餘力同時跑兩個實驗。

items.def_en: The time needed between placing a request and receiving the result.
items.example: The lead time for cross-section analysis is about seven working days.
items.example_zh: 剖面分析的前置時間大約七個工作天。

items.def_en: How long it takes to complete a task from start to finish.
items.example: We cut the turnaround time for FA reports from three weeks to ten days.
items.example_zh: 我們把 FA 報告的處理週期從三週縮到十天。

items.def_en: The gradual growth of a task beyond what was originally agreed.
items.example: Adding two more stress conditions is scope creep; let us handle it separately.
items.example_zh: 再加兩個應力條件就是範圍膨脹了，我們另案處理。

items.def_en: Responsible for the outcome and expected to answer for it.
items.example: The device team is accountable for closing the 8D by WW36.
items.example_zh: 元件團隊要負責在 WW36 前結案 8D。

items.def_en: Open to more than one interpretation, so it is unclear what is meant.
items.example: The spec wording is ambiguous, so both sides read the limit differently.
items.example_zh: 規格用字含糊，導致雙方對上限的解讀不同。

items.def_en: Short and clear, with nothing unnecessary.
items.example: Please keep the summary concise: three bullets on the front page.
items.example_zh: 摘要請寫得精簡：首頁三個重點就好。

items.def_en: Early and not yet confirmed, likely to change with more data.
items.example: These are preliminary results; the final data will come after retest.
items.example_zh: 這些是初步結果，最終資料要等重測後才有。

items.def_en: Arranged for now but still subject to change.
items.example: The tentative date for the con-call is Thursday at nine, Taiwan time.
items.example_zh: 電話會議暫定台灣時間週四九點。

items.def_en: Coming after something else in time or order.
items.example: No failures were found in subsequent lots after the recipe change.
items.example_zh: 配方變更後的後續批次都沒有發現失效。

items.def_en: Large enough to matter in practice, not marginal.
items.example: We saw a substantial improvement of 2.3 points after the fix.
items.example_zh: 修正後我們看到 2.3 個百分點的顯著改善。

items.def_en: Repeated or no longer needed because it adds nothing new.
items.example: The second screening step became redundant once the tool was fixed.
items.example_zh: 機台修好後，第二道篩選就變成多餘的了。

items.def_en: Meeting the rules, standards or specifications that apply.
items.example: The audit checked compliance with the customer quality manual.
items.example_zh: 稽核檢查的是對客戶品質手冊的合規性。

items.def_en: The person on the other side who holds the same role as you.
items.example: I will ask my counterpart at the customer to confirm the sample quantity.
items.example_zh: 我會請客戶端的對口確認樣品數量。

items.def_en: A task agreed in a meeting, with an owner and a due date.
items.example: There are three action items from the call, all owned by our side.
items.example_zh: 這通電話有三個待辦事項，全部由我方負責。

items.def_en: The written record of what was discussed and decided in a meeting.
items.example: I will send the minutes with the action items by end of day.
items.example_zh: 我會在今天下班前把會議紀錄和待辦事項寄出。

items.def_en: General agreement that everyone in the group can accept.
items.example: The consensus was to ship only the lots that passed the extra screening.
items.example_zh: 共識是只出貨通過額外篩選的批次。

items.def_en: The share of capacity, material or budget assigned to someone.
items.example: Our tester allocation for next month drops by twenty percent.
items.example_zh: 我們下個月的測試機台配額會減少百分之二十。

items.def_en: The evidence and reasoning given to support a request or decision.
items.example: The waiver request needs data as justification, not just an explanation.
items.example_zh: 特採申請需要資料作為佐證，不能只有說明。

items.def_en: Something taken as true without proof, which the conclusion depends on.
items.example: This estimate rests on the assumption that no new failures appear.
items.example_zh: 這個估算的前提是不會再出現新的失效。

items.def_en: A measured difference from the standard or expected value.
items.example: A small deviation from the target thickness was found on two wafers.
items.example_zh: 兩片晶圓被發現厚度與目標值有小幅偏差。

items.def_en: Written permission to accept material that is outside the normal spec.
items.example: The customer granted a one-time waiver for the affected lots.
items.example_zh: 客戶對受影響批次核准了一次性特採。

items.def_en: A short summary of what has been said or agreed so far.
items.example: Before questions, here is a quick recap of the three findings.
items.example_zh: 在提問之前，先快速回顧三項發現。

items.def_en: Further action taken to check progress or provide the rest of the answer.
items.example: As a follow-up, I will send the wafer maps for the two failing lots.
items.example_zh: 作為後續追蹤，我會把兩個失效批的晶圓圖寄過去。

items.def_en: Resistance or disagreement expressed against a proposal.
items.example: We got strong pushback on the two-week schedule during the review.
items.example_zh: 審查時兩週時程遭到強烈的反對意見。

items.def_en: To make brief contact to exchange updates.
items.example: Let us touch base on Friday once the retest data is available.
items.example_zh: 等重測資料出來，我們週五再簡短聯繫一下。

items.def_en: To return to a topic later, after other work is done.
items.example: Let us circle back to the cost impact after the FA result comes in.
items.example_zh: 等 FA 結果出來，我們再回來討論成本影響。

items.def_en: To include someone in a discussion or email thread.
items.example: I will loop in our reliability engineer for the retention question.
items.example_zh: 保存力的問題我會把可靠度工程師拉進來。

items.def_en: To check the progress of something raised earlier.
items.example: I am writing to follow up on the sample request from last week.
items.example_zh: 來信是想追蹤上週樣品申請的進度。

items.def_en: To reply to someone later with an answer.
items.example: Let me check with the fab and get back to you by Wednesday.
items.example_zh: 我跟晶圓廠確認後，週三前回覆您。

items.def_en: To show something to someone for their opinion or approval.
items.example: Let me run the draft reply by my manager before we send it.
items.example_zh: 回信草稿我先給主管過目再寄出。

items.def_en: To explain something step by step so the listener can follow.
items.example: Can you walk us through the failure signature on slide 3?
items.example_zh: 可以請你逐項講解第 3 頁的失效特徵嗎？

items.def_en: To look at a smaller part of the data in more detail.
items.example: If we drill down by tool, the failures come from one furnace only.
items.example_zh: 如果按機台深入細看，失效全來自同一台爐管。

items.def_en: To reduce a list of possibilities to the most likely ones.
items.example: We narrowed down the suspects to two process steps.
items.example_zh: 我們把嫌疑範圍縮小到兩道製程。

items.def_en: To eliminate a possible cause based on evidence.
items.example: The bake data lets us rule out a retention issue.
items.example_zh: 烘烤資料讓我們可以排除保存力的問題。

items.def_en: To investigate something to find out what is happening.
items.example: We are looking into the discrepancy between the two test sites.
items.example_zh: 我們正在調查兩個測試站之間的資料落差。

items.def_en: To keep someone informed as a situation develops.
items.example: I will keep you posted as soon as the screening result is out.
items.example_zh: 篩選結果一出來我就會隨時告知您。

items.def_en: To give someone the background information they missed.
items.example: Let me fill you in on what we found during the weekend.
items.example_zh: 我跟你補充說明一下我們週末查到的東西。

items.def_en: To give formal approval to a document or decision.
items.example: The customer has to sign off on the waiver before we can ship.
items.example_zh: 客戶必須簽核特採，我們才能出貨。

items.def_en: To delay doing something until a condition is met.
items.example: Please hold off on the shipment until the 8D interim report is approved.
items.example_zh: 請暫緩出貨，等 8D 期中報告核准再說。

items.def_en: To move a scheduled date to a later time.
items.example: We had to push out the qualification review by one work week.
items.example_zh: 我們必須把認證審查往後延一個工作週。

items.def_en: To raise a topic for discussion.
items.example: Thanks for bringing up the retention risk; we will add it to the plan.
items.example_zh: 謝謝你提出保存力的風險，我們會納入計畫。

items.def_en: To produce an idea, plan or solution.
items.example: The team came up with a screening method that takes only two hours.
items.example_zh: 團隊想出一個只要兩小時的篩選方法。

items.def_en: To make up a share of a total, or to explain why something happened.
items.example: Edge die account for eighty percent of the total fail count.
items.example_zh: 邊緣晶粒占總失效數的百分之八十。

items.def_en: To perform a planned task or test.
items.example: We carried out the split experiment on three lots last week.
items.example_zh: 我們上週在三個批次上執行了分組實驗。

items.def_en: To introduce a change into full production.
items.example: We will roll out the new recipe to all furnaces from WW35.
items.example_zh: 我們會從 WW35 起把新配方推行到所有爐管。

items.def_en: To focus attention on the most likely cause or area.
items.example: The commonality data let us zero in on furnace F02.
items.example_zh: 共通性資料讓我們鎖定 F02 爐管。

items.def_en: Matching or consistent with a standard or expectation.
items.example: The retest result is in line with our original baseline data.
items.example_zh: 重測結果與我們原本的基準資料一致。

items.def_en: Progressing as planned and likely to meet the target date.
items.example: The 8D is on track for release in WW36 as committed.
items.example_zh: 8D 進度正常，會照承諾在 WW36 發出。

items.def_en: Fully informed and able to work at the required level.
items.example: I will send the summary to bring the new engineer up to speed.
items.example_zh: 我會把摘要寄出，讓新工程師掌握最新狀況。
